description: This PHP class defines the FormatWithPayPeriod class, which implements a ValueFormatter interface to format pay period values in the OrangeHRM system. It includes a namespace declaration, a trait usage for ORM helper functions, and a method to return formatted pay period information, defaulting to a specific message if no value is provided.

classes.name: FormatWithPayPeriod
classes.description: A class implementing ValueFormatter for formatting pay period values, providing a default message when no value is available.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the entity value if present; otherwise, returns a default message indicating no pay grade details.
